package usecase

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type plannerMaterial struct {
	Key           string
	GenerationKey string
	Target        domain.Target
}

func plannerMaterialsForStep(raw json.RawMessage, stepID string) ([]plannerMaterial, error) {
	// LearningRouteReceipt.Steps is the exact array returned by ResolveRoute.
	var steps []struct {
		StepID       string `json:"step_id"`
		Requirements []struct {
			Material *struct {
				Key           string        `json:"key"`
				GenerationKey string        `json:"generation_key"`
				Target        domain.Target `json:"target"`
			} `json:"material"`
		} `json:"requirements"`
	}
	if len(raw) == 0 || !json.Valid(raw) || stepID == "" || json.Unmarshal(raw, &steps) != nil || steps == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrDependency
	}
	for _, step := range steps {
		if step.StepID != stepID {
			continue
		}
		materials := make([]plannerMaterial, 0, len(step.Requirements))
		for _, requirement := range step.Requirements {
			if requirement.Material == nil {
				continue
			}
			material := *requirement.Material
			keyBytes, err := hex.DecodeString(material.Key)
			if err != nil || len(keyBytes) != 32 || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(material.GenerationKey) ||
				(material.Target.Type != "concept" && material.Target.Type != "capability") || material.Target.Key == "" || material.Target.Version == "" {
				return nil, domain.ErrDependency
			}
			materials = append(materials, plannerMaterial{Key: material.Key, GenerationKey: material.GenerationKey, Target: material.Target})
		}
		return materials, nil
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
